three_findings.title: Cart qty +/- and addToCart have NO client-side throttle
three_findings.what: Each click dispatches posCart/quantity instantly. Rapid 100-click stress relies on Vuex sequential mutation. UI total computed reactively from store; backend recalc at submit = SSOT.
three_findings.impact: Cosmetic — under sustained click storm UI may render intermediate ticks. Final cart price = backend authoritative. No NF525/data risk.
three_findings.recommended_fix: Optional: wrap addToCart in lodash _.throttle(fn, 100) and qty buttons in _.debounce(fn, 80) to smooth UI under panic-clicks. Defer to V1.0.2.

three_findings.title: Customer-returning defaults are partial — addresses + loyalty only; no remembered order_type/payment_method/favorite items
three_findings.what: On customer select, the POS loads getUserAddress + _loadCustomerLoyalty. It does NOT pre-fill: (a) last-used order_type, (b) preferred payment method, (c) most-ordered items.
three_findings.impact: Cashier types same defaults every visit for repeat customers → friction. Owner mandate 'intelligent' partially unmet.
three_findings.recommended_fix: Add user.last_order_type + user.preferred_payment_method columns + GET /api/customer/{id}/insights endpoint returning {favorite_items[], last_5_orders, preferred_payment, avg_basket_size}. Render hint chip in cart sidebar: 'Habituellement Carte Bancaire + Frites'.

three_findings.what: After typing 'burger' in pos-v4-search and pressing Enter, page transitioned to /logout instead of triggering search. Could not reproduce after re-login. Possible focus-leak to a hidden logout form in db-sidebar.
three_findings.impact: If reproducible, cashier loses cart on accidental Enter — DATA-LOSS risk. Park-resume mitigates but bad UX.
three_findings.recommended_fix: Audit all <form> ancestors of pos-v4-search; ensure @submit.prevent + button[type=button] on logout. Add e2e regression test: type search query + press Enter → expect itemList call NOT logout.
